text:
anya (Product): FYI — FinCore just signed up for a private pilot. Key asks: VPC, HSM/KMS integration, and a 99th percentile API latency target <500ms for chat flows. They can commit to reserved capacity for 3 months. Timeline: pilot in ~6 weeks. Need to confirm feasibility across runtime/infra/security.
rob (Eng Runtime): Thanks. Is the 500ms 99th for single-turn chat or multi-turn with KV cache?
anya (Product): Multi-turn expected (avg 6 turns). They said they will use our session stickiness but want prewarm capability to avoid cold-start tails.
lee (Infra): Capacity-wise we can reserve GPU slots in the region but need an estimate. Do we want dedicated pool or burstable dedicated + shared fallback?
sam (Eng Manager): From eng side, prefer dedicated pool with automatic fallback to hosted variants to keep SLOs. Can we quantify slots?
anya (Product): FinCore expects sustained 50 rps peak for the demo, buffer to 75 rps. They'll run heavier at times.
rob (Eng Runtime): Rough calc: assuming model A (redwood-vicuna-16k-q4), avg tokens per request ~120, effective throughput on one A100 equiv ~10 rps for latency <200ms per request when batched optimally. For 75 rps we'd need ~8 workers with careful batching. Prewarm reduces tail.
lee (Infra): So request is ~8 dedicated GPUs + 2 warm spares/burst. I can open a reservation ticket but need sign-off from security for HSM network rules and a defined rollout plan.
maria (Security): HSM/KMS is OK but network policy must ensure control plane never touches customer keys. We'll need design doc + threat model review; that'll take ~1w once draft is up. Also need encryption-in-transit cert matrix for VPC peering.
rob (Eng Runtime): Operationally, runtime work: prefix caching enabled, prewarm hooks on session creation, and canary rollout plan. I'll need a small change to batcher logic to bias for low-latency small batches during demo window. Estimate 2w of eng work + 1w of qa.
sam (Eng Manager): Are we locking on model version? That affects quantization + perf. Product — confirm model.
anya (Product): We should suggest a tuned model variant: redwood-vicuna-16k-q4f (verified perf). I'll ask FinCore to accept that variant; if they insist on different model, we may need more perf work.
lee (Infra): I'll open infra reservation with tentative numbers: 8x A100 equiv, 2x burst, 3-month reservation flag. Also need to know region — FinCore asked for eu-west-1.
maria (Security): I'll draft the security checklist: HSM network diagram, KMS access pattern, audit log retention, and key custody notes. Hoping to get it ready in 4 business days.
anya (Product): OK — rough timeline based on responses:
- Day 0 (now): confirm model and pilot acceptance (anya)
- Day 1-3: infra reservation ticket + region provisioning (lee)
- Day 3-10: runtime changes (rob) + canary plan (rob)
- Day 4-8: security review (maria)
- Day 11-14: QA + staging run (sam)
- Week 4-6: pilot demo + hypercare
rob (Eng Runtime): Minor note: fallback policy needs to be explicit — if dedicated pool is saturated we'll route to hosted compatible smaller model. Need policy owner and traffic thresholds.
sam (Eng Manager): I'll own fallback policy doc and thresholds. Will propose: route to hosted-compat-8k when utilization >85% for >30s.
lee (Infra): Agree. Also add autoscale cooldown to avoid thrashing during demo spikes.
maria (Security): One more thing: HSM approvals might require SOC evidence from the third-party HSM provider. I'll list required artifacts in the checklist.
anya (Product): Great. Action items and owners: 
- Confirm model with customer: anya (by EOD)
- Open infra reservation (8+2, eu-west-1): lee (by +2d)
- Runtime prewarm + small-batch bias work + canary plan: rob (2w)
- Security design + artifacts checklist: maria (4 business days)
- Fallback policy doc and thresholds: sam (draft by +3d)
- QA staging run and acceptance tests (latency SLOs): sam + rob (by +2w)
Please add if I missed anything.
rob (Eng Runtime): Adding test plan snippet for perf test:
```
- synthetic workload: 6-turn convo mix, token dist: 30/40/50/120
- target: p99 <500ms end-to-end, p50 <120ms
- run: 30m sustained at 75 rps, 5m spike to 150 rps
```
sam (Eng Manager): I'll sync with QA to schedule the run.
lee (Infra): I'll include prewarm hooks in infra runbook and prepare terraform PR for reservation.
maria (Security): I'll share the draft checklist in this thread when ready.
anya (Product): Thanks all — looks like we can scope for a 6-week pilot but need quick confirmation from FinCore on model and region. I'll ping them now. :rocket:
deploy-bot: scheduled reservation ticket #RES-8243 opened by lee (region eu-west-1, 8 GPUs, 2 burst).
anya (Product): Filing this thread as the canonical cross-team sync for the FinCore pilot. Will update when customer confirms model.
